signs.Aries: This day brings with it a great sense of excitement. You have known for some time that things have needed to change within your relationship, and today you have a prime chance to do just that. But the opportunity may come in the form of an event, or surprise happening from out of the blue. However, it occurs it, will certainly do the trick!
signs.Taurus: Perhaps it is the sense of intrigue that surrounds a certain person that attracts you like a moth to a flame. Today you will have a chance to get to know them much better. Although they may seem fairly quiet and reserved, their whole aura crackles with energy, and you will feel yourself drawn irresistibly into their circle of friendship.
signs.Gemini: There is enough mystery in the air today for both of you, and not a little magic, as well. A wonderful illusion is being created in which change is extremely likely - so be prepared for anything and everything. What happens next may not fall into the bounds of everyday normality, it may even defy convention, and it will definitely be unforgettable. At least YOU will never forget!
signs.Cancer: Your partner may be exhibiting some strange behavior today. On the one hand your friend is very self-contained, virtually silent, and you cannot even get a civil good morning out of them. On the other hand, they seem extremely restless, as though waiting for something to happen. There is no doubt that positive change is in the air - so be ready!
signs.Leo: A long-standing problem may move toward resolution today. If you and your partner have lost that magic spark that used to characterize your relationship, then be prepared for an event that may seem disruptive at first, but which will ultimately bring you much closer together again. Sometimes we need a sharp knock to get us to change.
signs.Virgo: You spend an awful lot of time trying to maintain a sense of balance within yourself and in your personal relationships. Today a situation may arise in which that equilibrium is shattered, and you are left trying frantically to work out what to do next. It is best to relax and do nothing. Then conditions will return to normal more quickly than you might imagine.
signs.Libra: The energy of the day brings out the devil in you. You have been thinking about the possibility of a relationship with a certain person for some time now, and a unique opportunity presents itself in which you can prove how utterly desirable and wonderful you truly are. You may have a strange way of showing this, but this is perfectly natural. Experiment and succeed.
signs.Scorpio: You love new experiences, but deep down like to be warned in advance if a surprise is on the way. Today will probably bring an unexpected event into your life, and one that you may not have seen coming in your wildest dreams. Be prepared for CHANGE. It is on its way and will transform your circumstances for the better. You can expect to experience a real adventure.
signs.Sagittarius: You may experience a temporary sense of chaos in your life, but it will be well worth it. If you have become stuck in a rut in terms of your current relationship, then a sharp kick by the cosmos, applied to the right part of the anatomy, should do the trick. You have to change now, and soon the reason will become apparent!
signs.Capricorn: You may be the instigator of change in the life of either your loved one or someone you have had a crush on for some time. There's a strong possibility that you are about to do something irrational. You may be berated for this, yet later others will praise your wonderful foresight and timely sense of action. And all you have done is to follow your heart - for once!
signs.Aquarius: One chapter in a relationship may end, and also initiate a new beginning. Whether the partnership ends, or you decide to spend some time apart, or you commit to a new level of relationship, it is time for this change to occur. This is absolutely right and will set you on a new and more productive course.
signs.Pisces: There is the potential for sudden change within your romantic life at the moment. The current planetary configuration brings things to a head in such a way that a relationship that has grown sour may suddenly end, whereas a romance that has been quietly pollinating may suddenly bloom. Whatever the level of commitment, you may feel like becoming more involved, or possibly breaking away. Literally anything can happen.
